title: Prescription Renewals: Tailwise Pharmacy Desk Guidance
content:
*Care desk guidance, pharmacy.*

## What a renewal is

A Tailwise Pharmacy prescription that is refills exhausted or expired can never be filled again. Continuing the medication needs a renewal: a new prescription, recorded with renewal as its origin and pointing at the old prescription as the one it renews, sent to the veterinarian like a new order.

## Who places it

- Where the class is one on which the pharmacy requests renewals by itself, the pharmacy places the renewal itself when the last fill is dispensed, or the class's renewal lead in calendar days before the expiry date when fills remain.
- Where the class is not one on which the pharmacy requests renewals by itself, the customer must ask for the renewal.

## What a renewal does not do

- A renewal never extends the old prescription's expiry date and never restores its fills.
- An Autoship subscription linked to the old prescription is relinked to the renewal once the renewal is active.

## Desk questions

**The prescription shows refills exhausted but its expiry date is months away. Can the remaining validity be used for another fill?**
No. A refills-exhausted prescription can never be filled again; a renewal is a new prescription, and it does not restore the old one's fills.

**A renewal has been authorized. Does the old prescription's expiry date move?**
No. A renewal never extends the old prescription's expiry; the renewal carries its own authorization.

**When does an Autoship subscription start shipping against the renewal?**
The subscription linked to the old prescription is relinked to the renewal once the renewal is active.

## Illustration (hypothetical, class with a 14-day lead)

A prescription with fills remaining expires on 2026-10-15. On a class on which the pharmacy requests renewals by itself, the renewal falls due 14 calendar days before, on 2026-10-01. Had the last fill been dispensed first, the renewal would fall due when that last fill was dispensed.
